Sierra return details: Return Policy Information
You may return Merchandise purchased in-store to any open Sierra store within 30 days of purchase.
Our return policies are always subject to local, state and federal restrictions.
All other terms of our standard Return Policy apply.
Returns By Mail:
You may return Merchandise purchased online to any open Sierra store within 40 days of your order date. Alternatively, merchandise purchased online can be returned using our return-by-mail option.
Our return policies are always subject to local, state and federal restrictions.
All other terms of our standard Return Policy apply.
Return Policy
To receive a refund or exchange, items must be returned in original condition within 40 days of your order date when purchased online (including items shipped to a store) or 30 days if purchased in store. Original condition means the item is not washed, worn (aside from trying it on), damaged or altered and returned with all hangtags and original packaging where possible. Any item not meeting the condition standards of this policy will be returned at the customer’s expense.
Returns with a receipt received outside the returns timeframe may qualify for a merchandise credit. This credit is redeemable online or in store at any Sierra location.
Returns without a receipt will receive a non-transferable merchandise credit. A valid government-issued photo ID, name, address, and signature will be required for the merchandise credit to issue and may also be required in order to redeem. Any name printed on the merchandise credit must match the name on the photo ID presented at the time of redemption. Merchandise credits issued for returns without a receipt may not be used for online purchases. To learn about how we use and handle your information, please see our Privacy Notice posted on our website.
Oversized items, based on size and/or weight of the product, may have a shipping surcharge cost in addition to standard delivery and processing charges. Shipping and handling costs and shipping surcharges are non-refundable.
How to Make an Exchange, Replacement or Return
Process your items online within the returns timeframe, to create Instant Store Credit.
Return for Refund
Please follow the packing and return instructions to ensure prompt service:
• If you do not have your invoice, check your email and reprint the invoice if you went through our online exchange/return program. Otherwise, please enclose your Customer Number, Full Name and Billing Address with your return package. Enclosing this information helps us expedite your return.
• If you use the Return Label included with your original order, a return shipping fee will be charged for all returns. This fee covers return shipping from you to us.
• When using an alternate carrier: include your return address label; prepay and insure the package; and use a carrier with tracking. COD packages will not be accepted.

   - *Why:* Getting adidas’s premier dedicated lifting model for $59.99 (58% off the $145 original MSRP) in men's size 12 is the standout bargain of the entire comparison.    - *Why:* Built specifically for heavy barbell work. The rigid Hyperlift heel plate creates an uncompromising, non-compressible base that prevents heel collapse under maximal loads, while wide medial/lateral rubber wraps provide exceptional footing and durability for rope climbs and power lifts.

   - *Why:* Pure lifting shoes are too stiff for treadmill work and agility drills, while pure running shoes lack lateral stability for weights.
